in_marathi.name: Deeptimayr
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deep in knowledge, radiant in wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deeptimayr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deeptimayr is derived from the Sanskrit words 'deep' meaning 'deep' and 'timayr' meaning 'radiant'. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be deeply knowledgeable and wise. In Hindu mythology, Deeptimayr is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
